import os
os.environ['OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS']='1'
import numpy as np
z=np.load('/output/data.npz');x=z['x'];p=z['p'];perm=np.array([13,12,11,2,15,6,3,4,9,10,1,7,5,14,0,8]); n=128
src=x[:,:19].ravel();q=p[:,5:].reshape(-1,16); tt=np.tile(np.arange(5,24),n);seq=np.repeat(np.arange(n),19);Y=np.log(q);Y-=Y.mean(1,keepdims=True)
rng=np.random.default_rng(802); trseq=rng.permutation(n)[:96];tr=np.isin(seq,trseq);te=~tr

def design(lags=(),time=False,counts=False):
 fs=[np.eye(16)[src]]; names=['source']
 if time:fs.append(np.eye(19)[tt-5]);names.append('time')
 for l in lags:
  vals=np.full((n,19),16,int)
  for t in range(5,24):
   if t>=l: vals[:,t-5]=x[:,t-l]
  fs.append(np.eye(17)[vals.ravel()]);names.append('lag'+str(l))
 if counts:
  vals=np.zeros((n,19,16))
  for t in range(5,24):
   for lag in range(1,min(t,24)+1):vals[:,t-5]+=np.eye(16)[x[:,t-lag]]/t
  fs.append(vals.reshape(-1,16));names.append('counts')
 return np.concatenate(fs,1),names

def metrics(a,b):return float(np.mean(np.sum(a*np.log(a/b),1))),float(np.sqrt(((a-b)**2).mean()))
def prob(a):
 a=a-a.max(1,keepdims=True);a=np.exp(a);return a/a.sum(1,keepdims=True)
base=np.array([q[tr&(src==a)].mean(0) for a in range(16)])
print('arithmetic-source',metrics(q[te],base[src[te]]))
res=[]
for lags,time,counts in [((),False,False),((),True,False),((1,),True,False),((1,4),True,False),((1,4,6),True,False),((1,2,3,4),True,False),((1,4,6,9),True,False),((1,2,3,4,6,9,14),True,False),((1,),True,True),((1,2,3,4),True,True),(tuple(range(1,16)),True,False)]:
 D,names=design(lags,time,counts)
 A=D[tr].T@D[tr];B=D[tr].T@Y[tr]
 results=[]
 for lam in [.03,.3,3,10,30]:
  coef=np.linalg.solve(A+lam*np.eye(D.shape[1]),B); pred=prob(D[te]@coef)
  m=metrics(q[te],pred);results.append((m[0],lam,m[1]))
 best=min(results);print(names,'dims',D.shape[1],'best',best)
 res.append((best,lags,time,counts))
print('winner',min(res))
np.savez('/output/split.npz',trseq=trseq)

import os
os.environ['OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS']='1'
from pathlib import Path
exec(Path('/output/fit_utils.py').read_text())
# Freeze the transparent calibration structure before final full-data fitting.
# Peak: source x position. Off-target: source x position plus lags 1,4,6,9.
Dp=design(inter=True); penp=np.ones(Dp.shape[1]);penp[35:]=10
Do=design((1,4,6,9),inter=True);peno=np.ones(Do.shape[1]);peno[103:]=10
T=np.tile(np.arange(5),128);S=np.repeat(np.arange(128),5);Q=p[:,:5].reshape(-1,16)
Ye=np.log(Q);Ye-=Ye.mean(1,keepdims=True)
efs=[np.eye(5)[T]]
for lag in [1,2,3,4]:
 v=np.full((128,5),16,int)
 for t in range(lag,5):v[:,t]=x[:,t-lag]
 efs.extend([np.eye(17)[v.ravel()],np.eye(85)[T*17+v.ravel()]])
De=np.concatenate(efs,1)
results=[]
for seed in [802,1907]:
 rng=np.random.default_rng(seed);ids=rng.permutation(128)[:96];train=np.isin(seq,ids);test=~train
 cp=fit(Dp,Yp,train,.1,penalty=penp);co=fit(Do,Yo,train,.1,mask,peno);P=predict(Dp,cp,Do,co)
 etrain=np.isin(S,ids);etest=~etrain
 ce=np.linalg.solve(De[etrain].T@De[etrain]+np.eye(De.shape[1]),De[etrain].T@Ye[etrain])
 E=De@ce;E-=E.max(1,keepdims=True);E=np.exp(E);E/=E.sum(1,keepdims=True)
 E[T==0]=p[0,0]
 ekl=float(np.mean(np.sum(Q[etest]*np.log(Q[etest]/E[etest]),1)))
 ermse=float(np.sqrt(((Q[etest]-E[etest])**2).mean()))
 late=metrics(P,test)
 whole_kl=(19*late[0]+5*ekl)/24
 whole_rmse=((19*late[1]**2+5*ermse**2)/24)**.5
 print('split',seed,'early KL/RMSE',ekl,ermse,'late',late,'all KL/RMSE',whole_kl,whole_rmse)
 results.append({'seed':seed,'train_sequences':96,'heldout_sequences':32,'early_kl':ekl,'early_rmse':ermse,'late_kl':late[0],'late_rmse':late[1],'all_kl':whole_kl,'all_rmse':whole_rmse})
print('seed tokens counts',np.bincount(x[:,:5].ravel(),minlength=16).tolist())
print('late argmax matches',int((q.argmax(1)==target).sum()),len(q))
# Final fixed coefficients fitted only to supplied cached observations.
cp=fit(Dp,Yp,np.ones(len(q),bool),.1,penalty=penp)
co=fit(Do,Yo,np.ones(len(q),bool),.1,mask,peno)
ce=np.linalg.solve(De.T@De+np.eye(De.shape[1]),De.T@Ye)
A=cp[:16,None]+cp[16:35][None,:]+cp[35:].reshape(16,19)
O=co[:16,None,:]+co[16:35][None,:,:]+co[103:].reshape(16,19,16)
L=co[35:103].reshape(4,17,16)
B=ce[:5].copy();W=np.zeros((5,4,16,16))
offset=5
for lag in [1,2,3,4]:
 additive=ce[offset:offset+17];interaction=ce[offset+17:offset+102].reshape(5,17,16);offset+=102
 for t in range(5):
  if t<lag:B[t]+=additive[16]+interaction[t,16]
  else:W[t,lag-1]=additive[:16]+interaction[t,:16]
B[0]=np.log(p[0,0])
# Softmax gauge changes leave probabilities unchanged and improve readability/conditioning.
B-=B.mean(1,keepdims=True);W-=W.mean(3,keepdims=True)
O-=O.mean(2,keepdims=True);L-=L.mean(2,keepdims=True)

np.savez_compressed(out/'parameters.npz',peak_logits=A,off_logits=O,lag_logits=L,early_bias=B,early_lags=W)
import json
(out/'validation.json').write_text(json.dumps({'splits':results,'metrics':'Mean KL(teacher || predictor), natural logarithms; RMSE per token probability. Whole sequences are held out. Model search used the first split; the second is a robustness check, not an untouched final test.','teacher_argmax_matches':2432,'teacher_argmax_trials':2432,'observed_recurrence_matches':1973,'observed_recurrence_trials':2432,'estimated_uniform_mixture_weight':float(((x[:,5:]==perm[x[:,:19]]).mean()-1/16)/(15/16))},indent=2))
